'Deal 1 arcane damage to target hero. / Surge - If this deals more than 1 damage, it gets go again.'

Surge (CR 8.4.8) reads the damage this card ACTUALLY dealt -- after Amp, prevention and Arcane Barrier, which are exactly what push it past the printed number -- and tests strictly GREATER THAN, which is how every printed Surge is worded. The DEAL runs first so the gate sees this card's damage rather than a previous card's.

NO conditional_keywords DECLARATION HERE, unlike aether_quickening, which reads the same sentence. That card PRINTS GoAgain -- the card DB flattens the clause into an unconditional keyword -- so its printed copy has to be withdrawn. This one prints only Surge, so the go again exists solely because the gate granted it, and a withdrawal would take away something the card never had. That difference is also why the copier held this card back from aether_quickening rather than deriving it: 'printed keywords differ' is exactly this.
